items.bridge: The typed Meeting Intake workflow is canonical through exact prepared input, connected acquisition, cited decision, and private complete-group review. COMPLETE_MEETING_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE holds the entire summary-and-task group before batch or authority because the current one-observation verifier cannot prove all required Meeting-summary fields and body. Legacy write behavior and unsupported delivery effects are explicit intentional retirements.

The target proves exact policy, meeting, transcript, organization, project, and task grounding before judgment, then exposes the complete summary-and-task candidate only through private held review. No batch, approval, start, checkpoint, provider write, or verified outcome follows while COMPLETE_MEETING_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE applies.

The target loads bounded relationship history, rejects stale or unresolved meeting context, and never invents a task disposition or date. Typed needs-input replaces conversational stale-item recovery.

Exact prepared input, cited commitment grounding, and a private complete-group review replace prompt-only grounding. COMPLETE_MEETING_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE prohibits confirmation, one-time start, checkpoint, provider write, and verification for the group; external assignees are never fabricated and unsupported effects remain unavailable.
